name: uk.co.tacticafootball/tactica
title: tactica. football intelligence
description: Forecasts and picks: English Premier League (EPL), EFL Championship, EFL League 1 & EFL League 2

tools.name: list_fixtures
tools.description: Lists the upcoming fixtures on tactica.'s current forecast list for the English Premier League (EPL), EFL Championship, EFL League 1 & EFL League 2: fixtureId, kick-off time (ISO 8601), league, home team and away team, earliest kick-off first. Use this when you need a fixtureId, which every per-match tool requires; call it first. It has no forecasts or picks: use get_match_forecast, get_case_file or get_betting_picks instead for those. Free, no payment. Read-only; the current list at call time. No parameters.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: tactica.'s settled-pick track record: overall results and 1-unit profit, broken down by market, league and tier, with the running total and an observedAt time. Use this when you want to judge tactica.'s results before buying picks. Use get_settled_record instead for the individual settled picks. Free, no payment. Read-only; covers every pick settled to date. No parameters.

tools.name: get_match_forecast
tools.description: Home, draw and away win chances and expected goals for one fixture, with the model version and the time the forecast was generated. Use this when you only need the headline chances for a match. Use get_case_file instead for the score grid and the reasoning, or get_betting_picks for tactica.'s recommended bets. Read-only; the latest forecast for the fixture. Paid: 0.25 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

fixtureId.description: Required. The tactica. fixture id, copied from the fixtureId field of list_fixtures. Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

tools.name: get_case_file
tools.description: The full tactica. Case File for one fixture: the forecast, the score grid (exact-score chances), the evidence used and what drove the forecast. Use this when you need the reasoning or score-level detail. Use get_match_forecast instead for the headline chances only (cheaper), or get_betting_picks for recommended bets. Read-only; the latest Case File for the fixture. Paid: 1.00 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

fixtureId.description: Required. The tactica. fixture id, copied from the fixtureId field of list_fixtures. Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

tools.name: get_betting_picks
tools.description: tactica.'s official Betting Intelligence picks for one fixture, at most one per market (Result, Goals, Both Teams To Score), each with its family, market, selection label, tier (Conviction, Core or Edge) and tactica.'s chance for it. Picks only: no odds. Use this when you want what to back on one specific match. Use get_top_five instead for the strongest picks across all fixtures, or get_match_forecast for chances alone. A fixture with no pick returns a not-available error. Read-only; current picks at call time. 18+. Information, not betting or financial advice. Paid: 2.00 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

fixtureId.description: Required. The tactica. fixture id, copied from the fixtureId field of list_fixtures. Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

tools.name: get_top_five
tools.description: This week's Top 5: weekend picks released Thursday 23:00 UK for Friday–Monday games; midweek picks released Monday 23:00 UK for Tuesday–Thursday games. Returns the set on show (WEEKEND or MIDWEEK), each with match, market, selection, tier, chance and result. Weekend set on show until Mon 23:00 UK (Tue 09:00 if a Monday game is settling); midweek (3-5 picks) until Fri 09:00. Between sets: a not-released error with the next release time. Use this when you want the strongest picks. Use get_betting_picks instead for one match. Read-only. 18+. Paid: 10.00 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

tools.name: get_settled_record
tools.description: Individual settled tactica. picks, 20 per page, newest first: match, kick-off, league, selection, market, tier, outcome and score. Picks only: no odds or per-pick profit. Use this when you need pick-by-pick detail, for example to audit the record. Use get_track_record instead (free) for totals by market, league and tier. Read-only; every pick settled to date, with an observedAt time. A page past the end returns an error with the page count. Paid: 1.00 USDC per page, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

page.description: Optional, default 1. Page number, an integer from 1; 20 settled picks per page, and every reply gives the total number of pages. Example: 2
